name: Mailchimp
description: An email & SMS marketing platform combining marketing analytics, automations, and AI tools to help businesses drive revenue through integrated customer communications.
best_for: Positioned for small to mid-sized businesses (retail/e-commerce, hospitality, nonprofits, professional services, content creators) who want an easy-to-use email/SMS marketing tool without needing extensive marketing experience.
features: Drag-and-drop email builder with 300+ templates and AI content generation
Always-on marketing automations (welcome sequences, customer journeys)
Analytics dashboards for opens, clicks, and engagement
300+ native integrations (Shopify, WooCommerce, Stripe, Salesforce, Zapier)

alternatives.name: ActiveCampaign
alternatives.description: An autonomous marketing platform where AI agents handle email, SMS, WhatsApp, and CRM tasks backed by customer data.
alternatives.best_for: Growing businesses that want to automate marketing and sales work and reduce manual effort.

alternatives.name: Klaviyo
alternatives.description: An AI marketing and service platform built as an autonomous B2C CRM unifying customer data with omnichannel automation.
alternatives.best_for: Consumer/B2C brands, especially e-commerce retailers, wanting unified customer data and marketing.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: 1 seat, 1 audience, max 500 sends/month or 250/day. Cut in half from 500 contacts / 1,000 sends effective Feb 17, 2026.

tiers.name: Essentials
tiers.unit: flat, entry tier up to 500 contacts (price rises with contact-count tier, e.g. ~$75/mo at 5,000 contacts)
tiers.notes: 3 seats, 3 audiences, monthly sends = 10x contact limit, email/chat support only.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.unit: flat, entry tier up to 500 contacts (price rises with contact-count tier, e.g. ~$100/mo at 5,000 contacts)
tiers.notes: 5 seats, 5 audiences, monthly sends = 12x contact limit, up to 200 automation flows. Confirmed live on official pricing calculator (default 0-500 contact tier).

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.unit: flat, entry tier ~10,000 contacts, scales up to 200,000 contacts then custom/contact-sales beyond 250,000
tiers.notes: Unlimited seats and audiences, phone + priority support, monthly sends = 15x contact limit.

cons: Free plan was cut in half effective February 17, 2026 — down from 500 contacts/1,000 monthly sends to just 250 contacts and 500 sends per month (max 250/day), with only 1 seat and 1 audience, making it far less usable for even very small lists than it was a few months earlier.

There is a steep structural jump between the mid-tier and top-tier plan: Standard starts at $20/month (500-contact entry tier) but Premium — the only plan with phone support, unlimited seats/audiences, and predictive segmentation — starts at roughly $350/month with a minimum entry point around 10,000 contacts, leaving no gradual bridge between the two; self-serve annual billing is also only offered for Standard/Premium accounts with 10,000+ contacts, so smaller customers must pay monthly or contact sales.

Long-tenured customers were hit with a documented price increase in 2026: accounts still on pre-May-2019 'legacy' plans (never migrated to Essentials/Standard/Premium) saw an 11-13% price increase on billing cycles after April 13, 2026 — the second Mailchimp pricing change within the first four months of 2026, following the January free-plan cut.
